title: Cloud Security: telemetry ingestion
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for telemetry ingestion.

## Basis

Included monthly ingestion GB: Included telemetry ingestion per complete month; GB integer.

Telemetry ingestion rate: Security telemetry above inclusion; USD per GB.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Included monthly ingestion GB | Telemetry ingestion rate |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 50 | 0.46 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 100 | 0.46 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 250 | 0.46 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 500 | 0.46 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 1000 | 0.46 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 2500 | 0.46 |

## Tier comparison

For included monthly ingestion GB, the 50 Workloads tier lists 50 and the 2500 Workloads tier lists 2500.
